source: external POST :9999/{trigger,beat,log,...} with near-5MiB body and high concurrency
sink: Netty HttpObjectAggregator(5MiB), FullHttpRequest content to UTF-8 String, and bizThreadPool max 200/queue 2000
driver: body byte volume, concurrency, queued Runnable count
dimension: request-burst heap, worker threads, business queue pressure
bound: 5MiB per-request body cap, 90 second idle close, max 200 biz threads and 2000 queue are real bounds; service-unavailable threshold needs measurement
